lines.zh: 四蹄踏过白垩纪的蕨地，很沉。
lines.en: Four feet cross the Cretaceous ferns, heavy.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾在前，走起来很占地方。
lines.en: My frill leads the way and takes up room.

lines.zh: 我侧身挤过两株大树之间。
lines.en: I turn sideways between two big trees.

lines.zh: 我低头走，角尖快刮到地。
lines.en: I walk head low with my horn tips near the ground.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边把嫩枝咬断。
lines.en: I bite through young branches as I walk.
I take the front of the herd.
I cross the shallows, water over my hooves.
I go around the fallen tree.
My steps pack the soil down.

lines.zh: 我停下来看了看坡那边。
lines.en: I stop and look beyond the rise.
I lift a foot and go on.

lines.zh: 我朝群里的幼崽走过去。
lines.en: I walk over to the young in the herd.
I carry my tail low and pace along.
I stand and my frill turns slowly.

lines.zh: 我把头上的角对着前方。
lines.en: I point my horns at what lies ahead.

lines.zh: 我慢慢咀嚼，叶子挂在嘴边。
lines.en: I chew slowly with a leaf at my lips.
The wind passes the rim of my frill.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像块带角的大石。
lines.en: I hold still like a horned boulder.

lines.zh: 我听见林子深处有响动。
lines.en: I hear something deep in the wood.
I lift a foot and set it elsewhere.
I bring my snout to the ground and sniff.
My brow horn darkens in the light.

lines.zh: 我半闭着眼，什么也不想。
lines.en: I half close my eyes and think of nothing.

lines.zh: 同伴在我身后，我听着它们。
lines.en: Herdmates are behind me and I listen to them.
I give my frill a shake.

lines.zh: 我把头转向你，角先过来。
lines.en: I turn my head to you and my horns come first.
You stand before me, very small.
I size you up and do not move at once.
I look at you past the edge of my frill.
I ease half a step forward.
You back away and I stop.
I lower my head and point my horns at you.
We weigh each other with our eyes.
I bring my frill square to you.

lines.zh: 我颈盾对着你，谁也不动。
lines.en: Frill squared at you, neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我痛得叫出声，退了半步。
lines.en: I bellow with pain and give half a step.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我颈盾上，很响。
lines.en: That lands on my frill with a loud crack.
I shake my head and steady.
My hide is thick, but it still hurts.
I growl low and sink my body.

lines.zh: 我转过去面对它，不肯退。
lines.en: I turn to face it and will not retreat.
Blood runs down the edge of my frill.

lines.zh: 同伴围过来，站在我旁边。
lines.en: Herdmates gather and stand by me.
I keep that on my frill.

lines.zh: 你一扬那束蕨叶，我就过去了。
lines.en: You lift that bundle of ferns and over I come.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，凑近你的手。
lines.en: I lower my head to your hand.
This handful is young and soft.
I bite off most of it in one go.
Bits of leaf line my mouth.
Done, I raise my eyes to you.
Give more and I will eat more.

lines.zh: 我把角偏开，免得碰到你。
lines.en: I angle my horns away so as not to hit you.
I shift two steps along with you.

lines.zh: 你的手在我嘴边，我下口很轻。
lines.en: Your hand is at my mouth and I bite gently.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞到木头。
lines.en: You hit my leg like hitting timber.
I did not give even half a step.

lines.zh: 你这么一挤，我不得不侧身。
lines.en: That shove makes me turn sideways.
I lower my head, horn tips close to you.
I shift a step to give you room.
On impact I give a dull call.
My frill swept you.
You retreat fast, which is right.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的巨型，我这只角很沉。
lines.en: A Cretaceous giant — this horn is heavy.

lines.zh: 再推，我这只角就要低了。
lines.en: Push again, and this horn comes down.
We press head to head, horns crossing.
It rubs my shoulder with its frill.
We walk abreast, slowly.

lines.zh: 我替它挡住低垂的树枝。
lines.en: I push a low branch aside for it.
It moves off and I follow.
My chin bears down on its spine.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一片草地走。
lines.en: We circle the same patch of grass.
It calls once and I answer.
We stand leaning together.
I bite through a young branch.

lines.zh: 我把叶子从枝上扯下来。
lines.en: I strip the leaves off the branch.
This is too thick to bite.
I dip and bite the roots out.
My mouth is packed full.
I grind the leaves slowly.
Not fresh, so I spit it out.
I drag it over to the young.
The young branch cracks in my jaws.
Done, I go find the next clump.
Something moves beyond the trees.
I lower my head and aim my horns.
I growl low first.

lines.zh: 幼崽在我身后，我不能退。
lines.en: The young are behind me; I cannot back away.
I have fixed on it.
It has come near the grazing ground.

lines.zh: 我把颈盾抬起来，显得更大。
lines.en: I raise my frill to look larger.

lines.zh: 队伍散开了，我留在前头。
lines.en: The herd scatters and I stay in front.
Once fixed, the grass is forgotten.
The wind is against it.

lines.zh: 它离幼崽太近了，角已经低下。
lines.en: It's too close to the young. My horns are down.

lines.zh: 我一步跨出去，地面一震。
lines.en: I take a stride and the ground shakes.
If it has not backed off, it is on itself.

lines.zh: 我跟着它转，角一直对着。
lines.en: I turn with it, horns always aimed.
It circles and I shift slowly.
It steps in and I settle half a step.
I angle my frill to guard.
I make no sound and do not shift.

lines.zh: 它想走侧面，我先横过去。
lines.en: It tries my flank and I swing across first.
We face off across the grass.
I plant my hooves before shifting.
One more step and I charge.
It backs off and I do not chase far.
I raise my head a little.
Its legs are trembling.
I will not give up this grass.
I press my head down, horns leading.
That drives it backward.
I slam my frill into it.
My forehooves slam and soil turns up.

lines.zh: 它躲过一记，第二记没躲过。
lines.en: It dodged one and missed the second.
I hook it up and throw it down.
My horn scrapes along its flank.
I pant and lower my head again.
It tries to run and I bar it with a foot.
I shove it into the brush.

lines.zh: 这一撞用尽力气，我晃了晃。
lines.en: That ram takes all my strength and I sway.
It backs off and I root my feet.
I shake my head and spit out dirt.

lines.zh: 我从林子里踏出来，步子很沉。
lines.en: I step out of the trees, my tread heavy.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的蕨地，我认得这味道。
lines.en: Cretaceous fernland; I know this smell.
The moment I appear, the small beasts scatter.
I snap a few dead branches.

lines.zh: 我把颈盾抬高，看了一圈。
lines.en: I raise my frill and survey.
Herdmates come out of the trees.
I dip and take a bite of grass.
The river is close here.
I set down and soil sprays.
I pull the vine off my horns.
Something big calls far off.
I walk toward the young.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住一整丛蕨。
lines.en: My shadow covers a whole fern clump.

lines.zh: 风把我的味道送出去很远。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent far.
I pace across the clearing.

lines.zh: 这里够开阔，能看清四方。
lines.en: It is open here and I can see all around.
I lift a foot and test the ground.
I lower my head and raise it.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的皮，我踏着地躲。
lines.en: Fire sears my hide and I stamp away.

lines.zh: 落地时四腿一沉，我咬牙撑住。
lines.en: My legs drop on landing and I hold through it.
Water floods my nostrils and I jerk my head up.

lines.zh: 炸风推得我侧移了一步。
lines.en: The blast shifts me a step sideways.

lines.zh: 一支东西钉进肩，我扭头。
lines.en: Something pins my shoulder and I turn.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进骨头，我打了个抖。
lines.en: Cold seeps into my bones and I shudder.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，我连蕨叶都咬不动。
lines.en: Too long hunger and I cannot even chew ferns.

lines.zh: 雷顺着颈盾滑下，我整只一僵。
lines.en: Lightning slides over my frill and I lock up.

lines.zh: 蹄下空了，我庞大的身子往下沉。
lines.en: The ground vanishes and my bulk sinks away.
